meta.source: Elementel site (artifact 'Elementel', Nov 2026) and Project NOU — Elementel redesign (Nov 2026)

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground. Near-black in dark (the Elementel site, Kura, VG Companion), white in NOU light.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Sidebars, screens, day tiles and hover fills — one step off the ground.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Cards and tiles that sit on panel. In light, cards are white and separated by line.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: The selected tab and anything floating above a track.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: Selected sidebar row fill (paired with a 2px accent inset on the left).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Recessed tracks: tab strip, segmented controls, progress bars.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every hairline: card borders, section rules, dividers. 1px only. Decorative — never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, panel and card. 15:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, mono labels, idle icons and idle status dots. ≥5.5:1 on bg, ≥5:1 on panel in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE brand colour: pale signal yellow in dark, deep blue in light. Primary buttons, the mark, live status dots, today/current markers. Once per view as a fill. Safe as text on bg in its own theme (yellow 18:1 on dark, blue 6.7:1 on white) — never carry yellow into a light layout.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Glow ring around a live dot (3px), focus halo behind the quick-capture button, soft highlight fills. Never behind text you need to read.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors only, always with a word. 4.5:1+ on bg in both themes.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans JP", "Yu Gothic UI", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
families.glyph: "Noto Serif JP", "Yu Mincho", "Hiragino Mincho ProN", serif

styles.name: display-hero
styles.usage: Room heroes on the Elementel site. Always uppercase. Fluid: clamp(56px, 11.5vw, 150px).

styles.name: display-h2
styles.usage: Section headings. Uppercase, text-wrap: balance. Fluid: clamp(34px, 5vw, 52px).

styles.name: display-tile
styles.usage: Small tile titles (week days, map node names). Uppercase.

styles.name: display-brand
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the mark in headers. Uppercase, wide tracking.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: NOU page titles. Sentence case — NOU is the quiet, note-taking side, so no condensed caps here.

styles.name: tagline
styles.sample: Using AI to fix small everyday problems.
styles.usage: One line under a hero. Max 30ch.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each week I pick an everyday problem and build a fix in the open.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, selected rows, the app name in the sidebar.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: The problem, and a rough sketch of the fix.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Section eyebrows, status words, dt labels. Uppercase, muted.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Readouts, counts, timestamps, sidebar section labels. Uppercase; tabular-nums for numbers.

styles.name: app-glyph
styles.usage: Single kanji app marks: 脳 for NOU, 蔵 for Kura. One character, accent colour. Load Noto Serif JP with &text= for just those glyphs.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label nudges, tab gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills, small cards in a row, gallery gutters.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Grid gap between tool cards; eyebrow gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on mobile; card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: NOU card padding (18–20px); button side padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Tool-card padding; gap between header blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap under a section head; NOU page top padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: NOU page side padding; minimum band padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Maximum band padding between sections on the site (fluid 48–96px).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Gallery figures, small bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, sidebar rows (5–6px), the NOU app tile.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, tiles and panels on the Elementel site.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: NOU home cards and the tab track.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, the quick-capture button, avatar initials.

tokens.name: shadow-hover
tokens.usage: NOU card on hover, with a 2px lift. Cards rest flat — borders, not shadows.

tokens.name: shadow-tab
tokens.usage: The selected tab on the tab track, plus a 1px line ring.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating quick-capture button only.
